canned.title: Refund policy
canned.body: Thanks for reaching out. Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused items and within 14 days for opened ones. Once we receive the return scan from the carrier, the refund is issued automatically and lands on your card within 3-5 business days.

canned.title: Shipping delay
canned.body: Sorry about the wait on your order. Carrier tracking sometimes lags a day or two behind the actual movement of the package. I have asked the carrier for a trace and will update you here as soon as they respond.

canned.title: Password reset
canned.body: You can reset your password from the sign-in page via "Forgot password" — the email arrives within a minute or two. If it does not show up, check the spam folder and make sure the address matches the one on the account. Reply here if you are still locked out and I will reset it manually after an identity check.

canned.title: API rate limits
canned.body: The API allows 600 requests per minute per token, measured over a sliding window. Responses include X-RateLimit-Remaining so your client can back off before hitting a 429. For bulk work, batching into chunks of 50 with a short pause between them stays comfortably under the limit.

canned.title: Plan comparison
canned.body: Team is $12 per seat and covers shared inboxes, views and reporting. Business is $18 per seat and adds SSO, audit logs and priority support. Upgrades are prorated to the day, so you only pay the difference for the remainder of the current cycle.

canned.title: Closing thanks
canned.body: Glad that is sorted. I will close this ticket now, but replying to this email reopens it at any time — no need to start over. Thanks for your patience.
